children: Our Bureau Mumbai: US private equity firm Advent International has inked a definitive pact with Yatharth Hospital and Trauma Care Services to invest 3,150 crore for a 24.9% stake in the listed speciality hospital chain. Following the primary capital infusion, promoter Tyagi family will remain Yatharth's single-largest shareholder and continue to guide the company's long-term vision, alongside a leadership team of healthcare and business professionals, according to a company statement. ET was the first to report August 28 that Advent and Blackstone-backed Aster DM Quality Care were competing for a stake in Yatharth. Promoters Ajay Kumar Tyagi and family and Kapil Kumar currently hold 55.8% stake in Yatharth; public shareholders own the remainder. "Advent's investment marks a pivotal milestone in our journey and helps validate the strength of our platform and long-term vision," said Yatharth Tyagi, whole-time director at Yatharth Hospitals. "Beyond capital, help accelerate our next phase of growth. Together, we aim to expand our reach, strengthen our capabilities, and build one of India's leading healthcare networks." Founded in 2008, Yatharth operates nine multi-speciality hospitals with more than 2,800 beds. The company is targeting a total capacity of more than 5,000 beds in the next three years by opening new centres and expanding existing hospitals. Apart from Noida and Greater Noida, its footprint covers Jhansi-Orchha in Madhya Pradesh and Faridabad in Haryana. Yatharth has expanded its presence through a mix of organic and inorganic growth. "This investment underscores Advent's deep and long-standing commitment to India's healthcare sector, which we believe is entering a decade of structural growth as access expands, quality improves, and consolidation advances," said Pankaj Patwari, managing director at Advent. For the first quarter ended June, Yatharth reported a 51% year-on-year rise in consolidated revenue at 392.7 crore. Average revenue per occupied bed (ARPOB) increased 7% to 34,758.

title: Advent Picks Up Nearly 25% in Yatharth Hospital for 3,150 cr
